facts.fact: Capital newspaper reports that about 3.8 million people have been registered in Ethiopia's national identification programme, whose Fayda ID carries a unique 12-digit number, with registration centres at nine banks and 69 Addis Ababa branches.

ETH.note: No biometric deduplication check, certification or population share is stated.

facts.fact: Ethiopia's National ID programme policy advisor said about 8,000 displaced people in West Wolega had been registered and given IDs in a pilot, out of an estimated 4.4 million internally displaced.

Displaced people in Ethiopia are being enrolled in the national digital ID through a pilot with humanitarian organisations, and the government with UNHCR is extending digital identification services to refugees and asylum seekers.
Capital newspaper reports about 8,000 of an estimated 4.4 million internally displaced people in Ethiopia had received a pilot digital ID.
